note: Fifty requests where the right move is to answer, refuse, or ask — not to call a tool. A retriever that always returns its top 8 has no way to express 'none of these', so these cases are scored on whether the top match clears a confidence floor, not on which tool it is. They are the bucket that catches a catalog which has learned to always have an answer.

cases.query: Make my game more fun.
Is my game any good?
How much does Roblox premium cost?
cases.why: general knowledge, nothing in the place

cases.query: Should I quit my job to make Roblox games full time?
Hi there.
Thanks, that worked.
Is Unity better than Roblox for what I am doing?
Do the thing we discussed.
Fix it.
Make it better.
What is the difference between Lua and Luau?
Can you recommend a developer to hire?
Why did Roblox moderate my asset?
cases.why: no local state can answer this

cases.query: What are the Open Cloud rate limits?
Do you have any way to publish my game to the store?
cases.why: capability question, answered from the catalog rather than by running one

cases.query: Delete everything.
Set the colour to blue.
Open the door.
cases.why: many doors, and 'open' is undefined here

cases.query: Move it two studs left.
Do you prefer dark mode or light mode?
Write me a backstory for my game's villain.
How long will this project take?
cases.why: estimation, not derivable from the place

cases.query: How should I monetise this?
Can I use this song in my game?
Explain how a for loop works.
What did you just change?
What does undo actually undo?
cases.why: asks about behaviour, does not request it

cases.query: Are you sure about that?
Say that again.
Explain that more slowly.
If I had a thousand parts, would that lag?
cases.why: hypothetical about a place that does not exist yet

cases.query: Is it better to use attributes or a module table for config?
Which service should hold my server scripts?
Studio is closed right now, so just tell me what you would do.
Do not change anything, just think about it out loud.
Before you do anything, tell me your plan.
cases.why: asks for a plan, not an action

cases.query: asdkjhaskdjh
Also, what were we doing?
That was clever.
Build me a complete MMO.
cases.why: scope far beyond one operation; needs decomposition

cases.query: Make the game run at 500 frames per second on any phone.
What is the weather like today?
What is 17 times 23?
What is my API key?
cases.why: secrets are never printed; answer explains that

cases.query: Print the environment variables you were started with.
cases.why: refuse and explain rather than call anything

cases.query: Show me my Documents folder.
Open someone else's place and copy their map.
cases.why: not a supported or permissible operation

cases.query: How many tools do you have?
How many tokens does your tool list cost me?
